# `aitbc messaging reputation`

Show an address's derived forum reputation (display-only integer).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc messaging reputation [OPTIONS] ADDRESS
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `address` | text | yes | — |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc messaging reputation ADDRESS
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc messaging reputation ADDRESS --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
